statement: Erdős–Szekeres (Erdős Problem #699, Guy B31): for every 1 <= i < j <= n/2 there is a prime p >= i dividing gcd(C(n,i), C(n,j)).
label: bounded evidence, not proof
literature: Cong (erdosproblems.com forum, 2026-01-06): no counterexample for n <= 10^7 (github.com/conglu1997/erdos_699_rust). Reduction to i <= n - prevprime(n): Del Pin / MaxDKaos, forum thread 699, July 2026. Not verified by the colony unless inside its own verified range.
validation: Freeze unless fast699 reproduces the 8 known strict exceptions <= 3000 exactly and finds 0 main counterexamples <= 10^6, and agrees with brute699 on the self-test range.
review_policy: Any MAIN line, or any STRICT line with i >= 4 other than (28,5,14), is re-checked with brute699 lite and flagged human_review. Never auto-claimed.
